title: The Gap Between Hand-In and Assessment on an Equipment Rental and Demo Finding
content:
The longer kit has sat in the back of the shop between reaching the counter and being priced, the weaker the collective's account of what happened to it, and the figure the guest bears is taken differently according to that gap.

## The rule

Where the kit reached the counter more than 7 days before the assessment is made, the figure the guest bears is halved and taken down to the whole dollar below.

Where the kit reached the counter more than 2 days before the assessment is made but no more than 7 days before it, the figure the guest bears is taken at the recent look share of itself and carried up to the whole dollar above. The recent look share is 80 per cent.

In any other case nothing under this heading changes the figure the guest bears.

## The bands and their edges

| Days between the kit reaching the counter and the assessment being made | How the figure is taken |
| --- | --- |
| 0, 1 or 2 | nothing under this heading changes it |
| 3, 4, 5, 6 or 7 | 80 per cent of itself, carried up to the whole dollar above |
| 8 or more | halved, taken down to the whole dollar below |

Each edge is read strictly. A gap of exactly 2 days is not more than 2, so it falls in the first band; a gap of 3 days is. A gap of exactly 7 days is not more than 7, so it falls in the middle band; a gap of 8 days falls in the last.

## Worked figures on a hypothetical finding

Take a figure of 22.25 USD standing against the guest when this heading is reached.

- The kit reached the counter 10 days before the assessment: half of 22.25 USD is 11.125 USD, taken down to the whole dollar below, which is 11.00 USD.
- The kit reached the counter 5 days before the assessment: 80 per cent of 22.25 USD is 17.80 USD, carried up to the whole dollar above, which is 18.00 USD.
- The kit reached the counter 2 days before the assessment: the figure stands at 22.25 USD.

Note that the middle band rounds upward and the long band downward, so the direction of the rounding follows the band and not the figure.

## Point of judgement

**Which date the gap is counted from.** It is counted from the date the kit reached the counter, as the Equipment Rental and Demo agreement records it, forward to the day the assessment is made.
